steps.content: In front of you are the same streets, the same shops, and the same neon lights. At the center of Eastside's Fifth Avenue, three streets intersect.
At 3 a.m., you're standing at the intersection, right in the center.
Eastside is a city that never sleeps. Even at this hour, you can see many groups of people milling about.
You see them here too... but you're not sure if what you're seeing... are people.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Haha, another one!

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: We've had quite a few newcomers lately, haven't we? That weird one we saw last time has probably transformed, right?

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: Absolutely! It's tough being an oddball, and no one likes hanging around those weirdos, either. Isn't it much better to just be like us?
They clearly have normal human bodies and you can understand every word they say.
But unlike normal humans, they all have strange items in the place of their heads.

As for the two "people" in front of you, one has a dull monitor as his head, while the other has an old tape recorder. The blood-red eyes on the machine body are staring at you lifelessly, as if they're about to dissect you the next second.

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: Look at this weirdo with gawking eyes and such a dumb expression! Here, let's help you transform right now, so you won't feel bad.
The two chatty pedestrians slowly approach you. Seeing their strange heads, you instinctively hunch over in a defensive posture.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: Are you scared?

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: Don't be afraid. It won't hurt at all.
A strange sound rings out, and you see several worm-like black wires extending from the back of their heads. Each one is connected to a sharp, golden plug, dripping an unknown liquid.

steps.speaker: Passerby A
steps.content: If you become like us, you won't be so... weird. You'll fit in, think the same as us, and even talk the same...
The sticky liquid drips to the ground, eroding the road in front of you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I appreciate that, but I certainly, definitely, absolutely don't need this...
You slowly back away, scanning the area with your peripheral vision for any handy weapons or escape routes.

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: I've noticed that the newcomers lately aren't very willing to "transform"... Why is that?

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: This is clearly safe and convenient...
More electric wires with plugs appear from the back of their heads, looking like they could wrap around you and pierce right through you any second.
Thankfully, there's a narrow alley behind you. You start thinking about how to shake off these two eerie fellows with machines as heads.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Hi everyone, welcome to Call at 3 AM~"

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "The most loving radio show is by your side... Tell me about all the troubles and worries in your life. I'm all ears."

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "First, let's welcome our new listeners..."
Suddenly, a radio broadcast rings out from the residential building behind you.
To your surprise, these people stop approaching you, take out their comms devices, and start listening to the program.
Taking advantage of their pause, you quickly duck into the alley next to you, only to realize that you've underestimated how active the Eastsiders are at night.
You are like a mouse who ran into an alley full of cats. The moment you slip into the alley, three or four "people" with equally bizarre items as heads look up at you.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Is this world a mystery to you? Does it seem inexplicable? That's all right. You're just unfamiliar with it, and haven't learned to adapt. I will listen and answer your questions."

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Please join us, step by step. Come, repeat after me..."
There's no radio around, but for some reason, you can clearly hear the voice from the radio.
It's exactly the same as the voice you heard in the grocery store...

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Why are you being reprimanded? Because you did a bad job, of course. Why would anyone scold you otherwise?"

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Why are you being reprimanded? Because you did a bad job, of course. Why would anyone scold you otherwise?</color>

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Shouldn't you reflect after offending others? So you're wrong~"

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Shouldn't you reflect after offending others? You're wrong~</color>

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Don't you understand? You didn't even realize you did something wrong. That's why you're wrong~"

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Don't you understand? You didn't even realize you did something wrong. That's why you're wrong~</color>

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "That's what you're meant to be... without me, you're nothing..."

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>That's what you're meant to be... without me, you're nothing...</color>
The strange figures who blocked you just now are closing in from both sides, chanting along with the radio and converging on you.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Why obey? The majority is always right. The loudest voice is always right. The highest rank is always right. My voice is always right."

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Why obey? The majority is always right. The loudest voice is always right. The highest rank is always right. My voice is always right.</color>

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Inferior, clumsy, ugly, awful..."

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Inferior, clumsy, ugly, awful...</color>

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "That's what you all are. Don't question anything, don't doubt anything. If it exists, then it's justified. The loudest voice is always correct."

steps.speaker: Passersby
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>That's what you all are. Don't question anything, don't doubt anything. If it exists, then it's justified. The loudest voice is always correct.</color>

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "If you can't speak, your voice is useless. The redundant, ugly, clumsy... should not exist in this world. Just give it to me!"
The passersby repeat the words from the radio, faster and faster, louder and louder.
You are being watched, guided by their strange consciousness.
You feel your brain starting to spin. The oxygen seems to thin out as they gather, making it hard to breathe.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... no, why... why should I chant...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why should I... admit that I'm...
The moment you fall backwards, a pair of hands reaches out to hold you steady. A pain in your waist clears your mind.
If you want to live, chant with them!
